cases.source_title: SWAP: a Guide to Overwatch 2 Counters

call.how: Stay on Ashe on Junkertown first or third point and position well.

cases.reason: Ball and Tracer struggle to reach a well-positioned Ashe there, so the counter is softer than it looks.
cases.notes: Worked example in a counter guide, not a live match.

call.how: The swap to Shion is fine; keep fixing lane discipline and engage timing.

cases.reason: Shion suits this open map and feels good against Pharah, but it will not solve her problems (crossing lanes, engaging before the tank).
cases.notes: Enemy Zenyatta and Juno are mentioned at 35:18 to 40:20; the player's tank is a Doomfist (40:33).

call.how: Do not tunnel the Reinhardt just because Ramattra counters him; take a position with cover first, then pressure whatever is convenient from it.

cases.reason: Spilo mocks the clip's 'Ramattra counters Rein' logic: chasing the tank at the expense of position gets the Ramattra killed. Position first, target second (24:47 to 25:40).
cases.notes: Spilo reviewing a viewer clip about target priority. This is a how-to-play call, not a swap call.
